watch.en: Boil green vegetables and pasta quickly in plenty of water; simmer starchy roots such as potatoes slowly.
watch.de: Grünes Gemüse und Nudeln zügig in reichlich Wasser kochen; stärkereiche Wurzeln wie Kartoffeln langsam simmern lassen.

why.en: Plenty of water keeps released starch from making pasta sticky and keeps the colour and flavour of greens; a slow simmer lets the heat reach the middle and cook evenly.
why.de: Reichlich Wasser verhindert, dass frei werdende Stärke die Nudeln klebrig macht, und erhält Farbe und Geschmack von Grünem; sanftes Köcheln lässt die Hitze bis in die Mitte dringen und gleichmäßig garen.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 3.10 Vegetable Nutrition, Storage and Preparation, section Boiling
sources.sentence: Green vegetables should be boiled quickly in a large amount of water in order to retain their color and flavor.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 3.10 Vegetable Nutrition, Storage and Preparation, section Boiling
sources.sentence: Starchy root vegetables are generally not boiled but rather simmered slowly so that the heat penetrates to their interiors and cooks them evenly.

sources.sentence: The secret to boiling pasta successfully is to use ample water.
